name: Durham Castle and Cathedral
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Perched on a rocky peninsula above the River Wear in Durham, northern England, this pairing of a Norman cathedral and castle dominates the city skyline. The cathedral, begun in the late 1000s, shelters the shrine of St Cuthbert and the remains of the Venerable Bede, and its daring stone vaulting hinted at Gothic style to come. The castle once housed powerful prince-bishops and now is home to university students, who live there while visitors explore on guided tours.
